text:
Type: high-back rattan armchair
Use: relaxing, reading; living room, sunroom, bedroom
Style: bohemian, coastal, retro
Materials: rattan frame in a black stained finish, woven rattan seat and spindles
Colors: black, dark charcoal
Shape: tall fan-shaped back of bent rattan spindles, curved open arms, slatted seat, four slim splayed legs, light and open frame, medium visual weight
Feel: airy, graphic, relaxed, exotic
Goes with: white walls, natural textiles, green plants, light wood; bohemian, coastal or eclectic living rooms

product.name: STORSELE
product.description: The furniture is handmade and therefore unique, with rounded shapes and nicely detailed patterns.
